description: STR-10 (#2532): every callable is built with callable() from functions/src/platform/callables/callable.ts, whose authorisation policy is required. Fails on a raw onCall export (or a local onCall wrapper's export) not named in tool/audit/callable_policy_baseline.json, and on a listed name that is converted or gone, so the list of unconverted callables only shrinks.

rules.title: Callables state their authorisation policy through callable()
rules.instruction: Build a new callable with callable(options, {name, policy, input, handle}) from functions/src/platform/callables/callable.ts and a policy from policies.ts. Never add a raw onCall. When converting one, remove its name from tool/audit/callable_policy_baseline.json.
